clips.send: A dad sends this to his teenage son who says he's too busy for homework - awe that the richest man alive still finds the hour.
clips.caption:
Elon Musk reads for one hour a day, five days a week. He says it's the most important thing he does — more important than any meeting, any deal.

Kevin Trudeau asked him how he learned to build rockets. His answer: I read.

The richest man alive makes time to read every day. Most people say they're too busy for fifteen minutes.

Leaders are always readers. If you're not learning, you're already behind the people who are.

What's the last book that actually changed how you think?

#kevintrudeau #richhabits #readmorebooks #elonmusk #selfdevelopment #moneymindset

clips.send: Someone forwards this to a friend bragging about their salary - awe and a little shade, since Kevin spends more than that in a week.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once sat with multi-millionaires in the Billionaire Boys Club. One member handed out a list of over a thousand books he'd read in five years, ranked by how much he liked them.

Everyone in that room was worth over a hundred million dollars, and every one of them read constantly.

Meanwhile someone bragged about making half a million a year. Kevin's reply: he couldn't go back to living on half a million a week.

The top don't read occasionally — they read like it's their job, because it built their job.

How many books have you finished this year?

#kevintrudeau #billionairemindset #readtogetrich #wealthhabits #richpeoplethink #successbooks
